web.tour.alerts.text: {alerts} counts what's new: likes, comments, friend requests and news from your device. {settings} has your profile, password and language, and {show} to see this again.
web.tour.alerts.title: Alerts and Settings
web.tour.art.caption: Sunday at the lake
web.tour.collections.text: Select photos in Images and choose {add} to keep them together, like a trip. Open a collection here to rename it, share it as a gallery or delete it.
web.tour.collections.title: Make a collection
web.tour.dates.text: Photos are grouped by month, newest first. Drag the dates on the right to jump to any month; on a touch screen, drag the handle that shows as you scroll.
web.tour.dates.title: Jump to a date
web.tour.files.text: Switch between {list}, {grid} and {storage}, which shows what takes up space. Click a column's heading to sort by it, and again to reverse it, or use {sort}.
web.tour.files.title: Views and sorting
web.tour.friends.text: Copy {address} for friends to add you, or type their device's name under {add} and choose {send}. Requests to you wait under {waiting}: choose {accept}.
web.tour.friends.title: Add friends
web.tour.people.text: Click a face to see every photo of that person, and choose {name} to name them. Two faces of the same person? Select both with their circles and choose {merge}.
web.tour.people.title: Faces and names
web.tour.post.text: Choose + {newPost}, pick photos or videos from {library} or {computer}, write a caption and choose {publish}. It goes from your device to your friends' devices.
web.tour.post.title: Publish a post
web.tour.search.text: Type a thing or a place to find photos, or part of a file's name to find it in Files. A pick for photos becomes a chip in the field; add more chips to narrow them down.
web.tour.search.text_faces: Type a thing, a place or someone's name to find photos, or part of a file's name to find it in Files. A pick for photos becomes a chip in the field; add more chips to narrow them down.
web.tour.search.title: Search photos and files
web.tour.select.text: Click the circle on a photo, or drag across several; on a touch screen, press and hold. Then choose {post}, {collect}, {share} or {remove} in the bar at the top.
web.tour.select.title: Select photos
web.tour.settings.hint: A short tour of how to search, sort and share your photos and files, post to Social and add friends.
web.tour.settings.title: Getting started
web.tour.social.text: Your posts and your friends' show here, newest first. Click the heart to like one, write under it to comment, and click the number of likes to see who liked it.
web.tour.social.title: Like and comment
web.tour.upload.text: Drag files from your computer onto the page to upload them, then select some to {share} a link or {zip}. The lock makes a folder upload only: nothing in it can be deleted and old versions are kept.
web.tour.upload.title: Upload and share
web.tour.viewer.text: Click a photo to open it, then use the arrows, the arrow keys or a swipe to go through them. {info} shows when and where it was taken, the camera and a map.
web.tour.viewer.title: Open a photo
web.tour.welcome.text: This takes a minute and shows how to find, sort and share what's on your device. Every part of the app is in the menu on the left; on a small screen, open it with the button at the top left.
web.tour.welcome.title: Welcome to Off The Cloud
